subject: shinyapps cannot open the connection when read a csv file

messages.author: 1bd0eb1c612aa1ba
messages.subject: shinyapps cannot open the connection when read a csv file
parts:
Hi, 

I have a test app that read a csv file and plot the distribution. The app works well on local machine but have some error "cannot open the connection" when deploy to shinyapps.io. Please see my ui.R and server.R below.

ui.R:
library(shinydashboard)

header <- dashboardHeader()

sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(
  
  sidebarMenu(
    
    menuItem("Dashboard", tabName = "tab1"),
    selectInput("index",
                label = "Choose one to forecast:",
                choices = list("Dow Jones"= "DJI",
                               "Russell 1000" = "RUI"
                ),
                selected = "DJI"
    )
    
  )
)

body <- dashboardBody(
  tabItem(tabName = "tab1",plotOutput("plot"))
)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  header,
  sidebar,
  body
)



server.R:
library(shinydashboard)

server  <- function(input, output) {

  dataInput <- reactive({
    ind <- input$index
    imp <- read.csv(paste(ind,'_featureimp.csv',sep = ""))
    return(list(imp=imp,ind=ind))
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    imp <- dataInput()$imp
    hist(imp$importance)
  }
  )

  }
 
I guess the problem is I pass a variable when reading the csv file. Can anyone think any solution to it?

Thanks,
Joy
